notes: All checks performed by cargo xtask ci ran separately on the exact source commit. Native unit/integration tests used Cargo --no-fail-fast so an early failure could not conceal later suite results. No new skip or ignore was introduced; the pre-existing ignored tests remain recorded in the native results.
Original successful validation remains in validation_history with its original source commit. Earlier failed/interrupted review attempts are not counted as passes.

The first completed review gate stopped at an unchanged upstream control-server test: SendError after its 100 ms reply deadline. The exact binary and all 89 application tests passed on subsequent diagnostic runs without source changes.

Review validation corrected an invalid new bound-text fixture, serialized-write test producers, and File menu focus registration. Later targeted runs identified one existing reopen producer conflicting with the new live-tab focus behavior and two new headless fixtures discarding texture deltas. These fixtures now follow the documented protocol and existing headless rendering patterns while preserving the binding, dirty-state, and close assertions.

The full native run on 4ada579f found four engine fixture issues and three missing English source keys. Fixtures now use persistent unpainted rectangles, a nonempty group, an explicit normalized grid, and the real picker preservePlacement option; every existing assertion is retained. The three English source keys were added.

That same run also had four server share-connection timeouts while new WSL commands were failing. All seven team-link tests passed together afterward without a server change; apps/figcraft-server source is unchanged from the integration base.

The full native run on 8758b0a4 passed the server and English catalog checks and failed only the existing multi-layer crop rotation assertion. The subsequent fix recomputes target-specific placement for picker rotations while preserving default explicit crop replacements; no crop or filter assertion was changed.
An oversized-start ratio regression failed before the trial-bound correction and all layout tests passed afterward.

A filtered provider diagnostic exceeded its 90-second wrapper limit during import and is not counted as a full pass. The native-only/import regression passed separately; final native results above come from the complete renewed suite.
Firefox uses supported GECKODRIVER_REMOTE with a prestarted loopback Snap WebDriver, without desktop focus.

Removed two redundant too_many_arguments suppressions; the existing Clippy argument threshold remains 10.
Added missing imports to the image-picker regression module introduced by PR #618; assertions are unchanged.
Updated the exact inspection golden response for the document revision and capability metadata added by PR #1995, keeping the full equality assertion.

Fixed completion of picker-owned gradient and crop gestures from PR #618 while preserving unrelated move and text undo scopes; added real-input regression coverage.
Preserved same-frame image picker retargeting through discarded UI layout passes with viewport, document and page scoped temporary state; extended input regression coverage.

Follow-up review: simulate actual dry-run repairs, preserve hidden effects and accepted spacing, retain brand alpha and variable-owned padding, and avoid invented backdrops from translucent groups.

Follow-up review: distinguish explicit crop replacements from placement-preserving picker edits; classify text image targets by effective character fills.
Follow-up review: retain masks and text-style blends during rendering, solve coupled ratio fills without oscillation, and correct shared-edge coverage in the synthetic UI rasterizer.

Follow-up review: serialize provider writes, preserve capture-time Save As identity, expose local cancellation with keyboard access, require native provider bytes, and preserve close continuations and offline resource focus.
